reason: Page 6 of this MS has a garbled text layer (split glyph runs such as '970 01/22', 'Ca ambridge Interna ational', 'Que estion', 'Ma arks', and each key split as '3(' + '(b)(ii)'), so the printed keys 3(b)(ii) (p6 y192.0), 3(c)(ii) (y320.8), 3(c)(iii) (y345.6), 3(c)(iv) (y370.0) and 3(d)(ii) (y418.9) were not read, and the page-6 running header (y21-47), the 'Question Answer Marks' column-header row (y56-68) and the copyright footer (y550-559) were not recognised as furniture. The five keys are placed by hand at their printed lines; the page-6 header, column-header row and footer are whited out by position, and because the garbled word boxes do not match the drawn glyphs, all eight printed labels in the page-6 Question column (x64-112) are whited out by hand.
